name: Kubero Self-Hosted PaaS
free_limit: Free GPL-3.0 self-hosted Kubernetes PaaS with app deployments, CI/CD pipelines, staging environments, GitOps review apps and add-on integration; no software-imposed application quota.
watch_out: Requires a Kubernetes cluster and your own compute, storage, networking and maintenance. GPL-3.0 obligations apply when redistributing modified software; external add-ons and cloud infrastructure can incur charges.
